title: State of the Feed — Week of September 21–27, 2026
content_html:
This week's aggregator processed 11,296 articles across eight runs, delivering 608 quality articles at an average of 76 per run. AI-tech content dominated intake at 134 articles, followed by news (110), wellness (80), and science (64). Local coverage reached 50 articles while homestead content remained sparse at 8. Pipeline efficiency averaged 2.28 articles fetched per signal delivery, within normal operating range at 1.35–2.99 across recent runs.

Thirteen new feeds were onboarded this week, including technical and professional development sources (Two Minute Papers, The Pragmatic Engineer, HBR.org, Farnam Street), machine learning research (MIT News, DeepMind), design resources (UX Planet), and regional content from British Columbia and local news archives. Five existing feeds reported errors requiring attention: FolkloreThursday, alpennia.com, Adventure Journal, Yellowhead Institute, and NRDC. Three candidate feeds emerged from discovery evaluation with scores above 68, led by a3nm.net at 73.1.
